"""Publish actual32K event evidence, preserving original statuses and removing duplicate traces."""
from pathlib import Path
import collections
import copy
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import traceback
B=Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
W=Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/diag-prefill-leaf-service-events-20261012')
F=W/'bench/results/2026-10-12-prefill-production-leaf-events'
L=Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011/.lint')
O=B/'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('leaf_model_pub_owner',O);m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
def pin(p):return dict(path=str(p),sha256=m.sha(p),bytes=p.stat().st_size)
with (B/'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
 fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
 out=B/'main-prefill-leaf-service-model-publication-root-v1';assert not out.exists();out.mkdir()
 setup=json.loads((B/'latest-update-main-finalization-host-root-v8/record.json').read_text())
 env=dict(PATH=str(L/'venv/bin')+':'+str(L/'bin')+':/usr/bin:/bin',HOME='/home/yayoi',LANG='C.UTF-8',LC_ALL='C.UTF-8',PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1',RUBYLIB=setup['environment']['RUBYLIB'],GEM_PATH=setup['environment']['GEM_PATH'])
 r=dict(active=True,passed=False,complete=False,commands=[],gpu_executed=False,source=pin(Path(__file__)),environment=env)
 def save():(out/'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
 owner=m.Owner(out/'commands',save);r['commands']=owner.commands
 def run(label,args,wall=180):
  c,so,se=owner.run(label,args,env,W,wall=wall,cpu=wall*2,rss_cap=4<<30,text_cap=16<<20,total_cap=64<<20,file_cap=16<<20)
  r.setdefault('evidence',{})[label]=dict(stdout=so.read_text(),stderr=se.read_text());save()
  assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code']==0,label
  return so.read_text()
 try:
  root=B/'main-prefill-leaf-service-model-root-v1';derivations=[]
  for phase in ['startup','debug-on']:
   original=root/('xe-'+phase)/'record.json';value=json.loads(original.read_text())
   assert value['passed'] and not value['active'] and value['model_normal_close'] and value['kernel_gate_passed']
   assert all(m.closed(c) and not c['cleanup'] for c in value['commands']+value['guard_commands'])
   derivative=copy.deepcopy(value);changes=[]
   for key in ['service_event_lines','protocol_events','request_protocol','owned_progress']:
    if key in derivative:
     encoded=json.dumps(derivative[key],sort_keys=True).encode();changes.append(dict(json_pointer='/'+key,bytes=len(encoded),sha256=hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest(),reason='Duplicate timeline/protocol/polling; parsed categories, exact token/LP5 validation and wall boundaries retained.'));del derivative[key]
   for label,evidence in derivative.get('evidence',{}).items():
    for key in ['stdout','stderr']:
     if key in evidence:
      text=evidence.pop(key);evidence[key+'_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest();evidence[key+'_bytes']=len(text.encode())
   target=F/'receipts'/ ('main-prefill-leaf-service-model-'+phase+'-v1.json');target.write_text(json.dumps(derivative,indent=2)+'\n')
   derivations.append(dict(original=pin(original),archived=pin(target),changes=changes,scope='Original private receipt unchanged; all measurements/fault/normal-close/validation outcomes preserved. Raw outputs summarized in their exact structured fields.'))
  v=json.loads((root/'xe-debug-on/record.json').read_text());assert v['service_summary']['status']=='complete' and v['validation']['token_logprob_sha256']=='f8aca127a7f45238d7567368ee8ad5c26c4a3488fc0cc6b83a4d19d50a6cbd6f'
  aggregate=collections.defaultdict(lambda:dict(count=0,valid=0,bytes=0,host_submit_ns=0,service_sum_ns=0))
  for row in v['service_categories']:
   key=(row['kind'],row['backend'],row['src'],row['dst'],row['N'],row['K'])
   for field in aggregate[key]:aggregate[key][field]+=int(row[field])
  rows=[dict(kind=k[0],backend=k[1],src=k[2],dst=k[3],N=k[4],K=k[5],**row) for k,row in aggregate.items()]
  results=dict(actual_input_tokens=32768,actual_generated_tokens=16,configured_context=262144,
               source_commit=v['candidate_commit'],binary=v['binary'],service_summary=v['service_summary'],category_count=len(v['service_categories']),aggregate_categories=rows,
               validation=v['validation'],host_wall_samples=v['host_wall_samples'],normal_close=v['model_close'],kernel_gate_passed=v['kernel_gate_passed'],
               performance_sample_eligible=False,scope='One validation/tracing/profiling-enabled diagnostic. Selected leaf command spans may overlap and profiling changes queue behavior; no physical bandwidth or normal-speed claim.',
               decision='Prioritize transfer submission count, copy command path and larger chunks before grouped GEMM tile tuning; qualify quiet instrumentation overhead and uncovered GDN/QSA/dense service next.',
               full_context_262144_runtime_qualified=False,restore_qualified=False,
               displayed_engine=v['effective_info']['engine'],version_label_limit='Existing engine label remainsxe0.1.40.2.2; source identity is the Git revision/binary hash and curated upstream/Xe imports, not an unmodified release.',
               unmodified_references=dict(official_main='7695859aa13afb248bdb4d36f9b2e95707db079d',xe_main='da3d426079019daa6e01388d03b0d94ae67070b7',fresh_recheck=pin(B/'main-prefill-leaf-service-remote-recheck-v1.json')))
  (F/'MODEL_RESULTS.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')
  (F/'model-receipt-derivations.json').write_text(json.dumps(derivations,indent=2)+'\n')
  names=['main-prefill-leaf-service-runtime-review-v1.json','main-prefill-leaf-service-startup-review-v1.json','main-prefill-leaf-service-remote-recheck-v1.json',Path(__file__).name]
  for name in names:
   p=B/name;(F/'controllers'/ (name+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(dict(original=pin(p),text=p.read_text()),indent=2)+'\n')
  (F/'REPORT.md').write_text('# Production prefill command-event measurement\n\nOn Arc B570 with LLVM7.1.1/Clang22.1/libSYCL9, the32K+GEN16 production diagnostic captured129820 valid events. The sixteen output IDs and all reported LP5 values exactly matched the selected baseline. Startup, normal QUIT, fresh integer health and kernel fault checks passed; no reset or retry occurred.\n\n| Selected category | Commands | Event spans | Host submit wall |\n| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |\n| Host-USM to device-USM copy |97732|69.651 s|11.092 s|\n| Grouped XMX GU |5944|3.345 s|0.681 s|\n| Grouped XMX Down |5944|1.662 s|0.628 s|\n| Native GU dequant |10096|2.545 s|1.096 s|\n| Native Down dequant |10096|1.961 s|1.094 s|\n\nCopy request extents were200326113280 bytes. These are command-action spans, not physical PCIe bandwidth; different queues may overlap. Dense projections, GDN, QSA and other uncaptured work are outside this summary. Host submission covers the existing wrapper/API interval, excluding pointer classification and collector insertion. Query/aggregation took4.002 s. Engine prefill105936.4 ms and decode2555.9 ms belong to this instrumented diagnostic, not a clean speed distribution. See MODEL_RESULTS.json and each original category for exact values.\n\nThe transfer path and submission count now have a measured reason to take priority over grouped GEMM tile tuning. Copy cohorts and larger chunks remain candidates, with no implementation or speedup claimed. Next qualify quiet instrumentation overhead and the remaining dense/GDN/QSA leaf coverage, then test bounded native Copy2D cohorts with the existing per-slot last-reader/credit protocol.\n\nBoth free and contrib-llvm builds passed with no new lint finding after correcting the original failed lint. Host-only ASan/UBSan checks passed cap200001, unavailable profiling, negative host time and scope reset. Seven finite GPU fixtures passed exact opt-in values and the simulated DP4a configuration, including1280 outputs and16 canaries. Integrated graphics, NVIDIA, full smaller-model memory admission,262144-token input and RESTORE remain unverified.\n\nFresh remote main and peeled tags are unchanged: officialv0.1.43 at7695859a and Xexe0.1.42 atda3d4260. Prior pristine32K measurements and the upstream server completion atfcb86a77 remain the update evidence. The displayed engine label is stillxe0.1.40.2.2; use the Git revision and binary hash to identify this curated build. The selected normal model binary0691/ed65 remains unchanged.\n\nCommitted receipts retain individual outcomes, exact categories, token/LP5 fingerprints, provider/command/environment and fault/closure evidence. Duplicate protocol/event strings and full successful traces are removed from archival derivatives; original receipt hashes and derivations are recorded. Raw artifact cleanup follows under the exclusive measurement lock.\n')
  files=sorted(str(p.relative_to(W)) for p in F.rglob('*') if p.is_file())
  run('report-lints',['/bin/bash','tools/lint/run.sh',*files],300)
  run('whole-reuse',[str(L/'venv/bin/reuse'),'lint','--quiet'],180)
  run('stage',['/usr/bin/git','add',str(F.relative_to(W))])
  run('commit',['/usr/bin/git','commit','-m','docs(bench): record production prefill command service spans'])
  run('push',['/usr/bin/git','push'],300)
  r['commit']=run('head',['/usr/bin/git','rev-parse','HEAD']).strip();assert not run('clean',['/usr/bin/git','status','--porcelain']).strip();r['complete']=True
 except BaseException as error:r.update(error=repr(error),traceback=traceback.format_exc())
 finally:r.update(active=owner.active is not None,finished_utc=m.utc());r['passed']=bool(r['complete'] and not r['active'] and not r.get('error'));save()
 print(json.dumps({k:r.get(k) for k in ['passed','complete','error','commit']}));raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
